name: Bleu des Causses
origin: France - Causses, Aveyron, Gorges du Tarn

compounds.quote: | **dimethyl sulfide (CH3SCH3)** | **70 µg/kg = 70 ppb, apparent/headspace calibrated, CAU 100-d Valmont**. Row triplets (H,C,%): PF 1267 7 20, PO 970 7 42, PG 2218 11 30, **CAU 58345 70 14**, AUV 256 8 12. Text confirms: supposed that dimethyl sulfide was present in Bleu des Causses at greater than threshold level (70 ppb), and contributed to overall aroma. Detection threshold 0.3 ppb in water and 9 ppb in milk |  |

compounds.name: 2-phenylethanol

ammonia.reason: Deamination of amino acids during 100-d Penicillium roqueforti proteolysis in cave-aged paste.

animal_barnyard.reason: p-Cresol not listed, indole not detected, 4-ethyl phenol only trace in CAU.

bitter.reason: Accumulation of hydrophobic peptides from chymosin plus P. roqueforti aspartyl proteinases.

blue_moldy.reason: P. roqueforti fatty-acid beta-oxidation to 2-pentanone 3440, 2-heptanone 2855, 2-nonanone 1600 ug/kg.

browning.reason: High-moisture rennet curd with depleted lactose limits Maillard during heating.

buttery.reason: Diacetyl not reported and acetoin not detected in CAU; methyl ketones dominate over citrate-diacetyl pathway.

cheesy_sweaty.reason: Highest titratable FFA 17.45 meq/100g fat from P. roqueforti lipase releasing butanoic-hexanoic acids.

creaminess.reason: 45% FDM plus extensive proteolysis-lipolysis softening unpressed paste to creamy matrix.

crumbliness.reason: Unpressed pierced rennet curd with blue fissures fractures under proteolyzed network.

firmness.reason: Uncooked unpressed blue at ~45% moisture and minimum 53% dry matter gives sliceable semi-soft body.

floral_honey.reason: Limited Ehrlich pathway: phenylethanol only 130 ug/kg and phenylacetaldehyde not detected.

fruity.reason: Low yeast esterification: ethyl butanoate 55 and ethyl hexanoate 70 ug/kg apparent.

goaty.reason: Cow milk without caprine branched acids; moderate C6-C8 from lipolysis only.

malty_nutty.reason: No aldehydes found in Bleu des Causses; 3-methylbutanal and phenylacetaldehyde not detected.

melt.reason: Rennet curd pH ~6.2 with solubilized colloidal calcium allows moderate flow on heating.

mushroom_earthy.reason: Linoleic acid oxidation to 1-octen-3-ol ~10 ug/kg plus P. roqueforti mycelium.

oil_off.reason: High free fatty acids and free fat from lipolysis release oil on heating.

smoky.reason: Unsmoked cave-aged cheese with no guaiacol reported.

sour_vinegar.reason: Lactic acid neutralized by ammonia and low acetic/propanoic acid in aged blue.

stretch.reason: Rennet-set, non-kneaded curd without pasta-filata thermomechanical alignment.

sulfur_cooked.reason: Methionine catabolism to dimethyl sulfide 70 ppb and dimethyl disulfide 90 ppb, highest of tested blues.

sweet.reason: Lactose depleted by starter fermentation with no residual sugars.

umami.reason: Extended proteolysis liberating glutamate and savory peptides.
